title: Ntlo ya Segosi ya Galase e e Nang le Seipone
intro: Bona ka leitlho la mogopolo naga e e kgakala ya dikhumo le bontlentle koo go obamelwang letsatsi mo boemong jwa Mmopi wa lone. Lekwalo le goroga le tshotse pitso e e ka se kang ya itlhokomolosiwa, mme loeto lo simolola go ya kwa kgotleng e kgolo go feta epe e e kileng ya bonwa pele. Moo, thetso e tla senolwa ke fatshe le thetsang mahlo, mme motsotso wa ho hlaka o tla fetola ntho e nngwe le e nngwe.
clues: Ke ne ke busa lefatshe le le atlegileng le batho ba lone ba neng ba khubamela letsatsi mo boemong jwa ga Allah.
Ke ne ka amogela lekwalo le le tlotlegang le le mpitsa gore ke se ka ka ikgodisa mme ke tle ka go ineela mo go Allah.
Ke ne ka buisana le lekgotla la me mme ka tlhopha bodipolomate pele, ka romela mpho go leka moromedi.
Ke ne ka tla kwa Sulayman, mme ke ne ka newa setulo sa me sa bogosi ke ikgakantse go leka gore a ke a lemoga.
Ke ne ka tsena mo ntlong e e kwa godimo ya segosi e ke neng ke tsaya gore bodilo jwa yone jo bo borethe jwa galase ke metsi a a boteng.
Ke ne ka bolela gore ke ineela le Sulayman mo go Allah, Morena wa mafatshe.

identity.label: Ke Mang?
options: Kgaitsadie Musa
Mosadi wa ga Abu Lahab
Mosadi wa ga Nuh
Bilqis, Mmusi wa Saba
Zulaikha, Mosadi wa ga Al-Aziz

trial.label: Teko/Tiragalo
options: E meditswe ke tlhapi e kgolo mo botennyeng jwa lewatle
O tlhasetswe ke bolwetse jwa dingwaga di le dintsi le go latlhegelwa ke ba lelapa
O laetswe go ntsha ngwana yo o rategang setlhabelo mo torong
E lekilwe ke setulo sa bogosi se se ikgakantseng le ntlo ya segosi ya galase
A latlhelwa mo molelong o o tukang ka ntlha ya go thuba medingwana
trial.answer: E lekilwe ke setulo sa bogosi se se ikgakantseng le ntlo ya segosi ya galase

location.label: Elemente ya Botlhokwa
options: Areka e agilwe mo godimo ga metsi
Logaga lwa botshabelo jwa boroko
Bodilo jwa ntlo ya segosi ya kristale (Sarh)
Noka ya Nile ka nako ya khudugo
Molelo o o baakantsweng ke baobamedi ba medingwana
location.answer: Bodilo jwa ntlo ya segosi ya kristale (Sarh)

outcome.label: Botso
options: Ke komeditswe ke lefatshe le matlotlo a me
O ne a sala a sa dumele mme a nyelediwa le batho ba gaetsho
E ineetse le Sulayman go Allah, Morena wa mafatshe
A nwela mo lewatleng a ntse a latelela badumedi
O ne a fetolwa letlapa ka ntlha ya go tlola Sabata
outcome.answer: E ineetse le Sulayman go Allah, Morena wa mafatshe

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
